findings.sfr_manifest_errors_nonfatal: The AppleARMSFRManifest / AppleARMBootPerf errors are emitted inside the iokit-time-init window, but execution reaches 'iokit-time-init done' and later markers. They are not the halt point. They reflect absent firmware /chosen/secure-boot-hashes, /chosen/iBoot and boot-manifest-hash on this non-Apple firmware.
findings.halt_location_inference: The last published marker is the 0032 'source-storage-start begin' emitted immediately before native_source_storage_start() in bsd_init.c. Execution is inside that function. SourceStorage.cpp has no sub-step markers, so the exact blocking call (kext load, policy handoff, class registration, waitForMatchingService, or UFS init/attach/start) is not distinguishable from this photo.
known_blocking_items: native_ufs_source_create()/init()/attach()/start(): UFS firmware queue/SMMU/DMA takeover, policy-gated block authentication
APFS root mount at vfs_mountroot() is a later, still-unverified gate

next_step: Add synchronous sub-step checkpoints inside native_source_storage_start() so the next photo localizes the exact blocking call before any firmware/DMA change is attempted.
